title: Installments Falling Due After Default, Collected on Reinstatement
content:
**Revenue Cycle Policy Manual — Patient Payment Plans: installments falling due after a default**

**Clause.** Installments whose due date passed after the plan's default date, counted as the whole months from the plan's first due date to today plus one less the whole months from the first due date to the default date plus one, are collected with the reinstatement payment at the regular installment: in full on a plan accepted at least 6 whole months before today, at one half on a plan accepted less than 6 whole months before today, and not at all when no installment has fallen due since the default.

**Amount collected.** The amount added to the reinstatement payment for these installments is the regular installment multiplied by their number and by the share below, taken to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up.

| Installments fallen due since the default | Plan accepted at least 6 whole months before today | Share collected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | Yes | In full (1) |
| 1 or more | No | One half (0.5) |
| None | Yes or No | Nothing |

**Counting.** Both counts are taken from the plan record's first due date: (a) whole months from the first due date to today, plus one; (b) whole months from the first due date to the default date, plus one. The installments fallen due since the default are (a) less (b). Seasoning is counted in whole months from the plan's acceptance date to today.

## Worked counts (hypothetical plans; regular installment 95.00)

**Plan A.** Accepted 10 December; first due date 15 January; default date 20 April; today 28 June.
- (a) 15 January to 28 June is 5 whole months; plus one, 6.
- (b) 15 January to 20 April is 3 whole months; plus one, 4.
- Installments fallen due since the default: 6 less 4, that is 2.
- Seasoning: 10 December to 28 June is 6 whole months, which is at least 6, so they are collected in full: 2 installments of 95.00, that is 190.00.

**Plan B.** Accepted 10 February; first due date 15 March; default date 20 May; today 28 July.
- (a) 4 whole months plus one, 5; (b) 2 whole months plus one, 3; fallen due since the default, 2.
- Seasoning: 5 whole months, less than 6, so they are collected at one half: one half of 190.00, that is 95.00.

**Plan A on an earlier day.** Had today been 10 May, (a) would be 3 whole months plus one, that is 4, equal to (b): no installment would have fallen due since the default and nothing would be collected for them.
